document.title: Terrorism: Bin Ladin Plans Delayed but Not Abandoned [Excised]
document.publisher: National Security Archive (GWU), The Central Intelligence Agency 9/11 File: Hundreds of Secret Agency Documents on Osama Bin Laden Declassified
document.note: Senior Executive Intelligence Brief. Source: 9/11 Commission Report, Chapter 8, Endnote 28. One of a series of June-September 2001 SEIBs warning of al-Qaeda attacks.

persons.name: Usama bin Ladin
persons.role: Subject of the CIA Senior Executive Intelligence Brief; leader of planned attacks, per the title

events.description: CIA Senior Executive Intelligence Brief issued, assessing that Bin Ladin's attack plans were delayed but not abandoned. Most of the text is excised.

sources_cited: CIA Senior Executive Intelligence Brief, 13 July 2001
key_claims: The CIA assessed in July 2001 that Bin Ladin's attack plans were delayed but not abandoned.
The brief says plans to attack were still in train, though the text is heavily excised.
